message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready and that you look forward to putting this job on the shop floor. That is the right spirit for the HX pump shaft, and we would like to find a price that works for both family companies.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

Several bidders are competing for this part, and the award will go to the best overall package. We cannot promise it in advance. Still, Option A is the package we can approve, because it answers the quality record and the competing offer with one clear, fair price, and it gives your machines a firm job to run.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

We know what your shop has meant to us over the years, and we would be glad to see that cooperation grow with the new HX series. Please take Option A to your office manager for costing and tell me where it stands.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

You sent us your price plainly and quickly, and we would like to answer in the same spirit: one family company to another, with a fair solution for both sides.

For the pump shaft of our new HX series, we are comparing several bidders, and the order goes to the best overall package. Option A is the package we can approve: it brings your price and our requirements together in a way that works for both of us. Here is how we see the position.

On the competing offer:
Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

On your plans:
Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03).

On quality:
Your quality was 318 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70250@2026Q3).

You have been a dependable partner to us, and we would like to build on that with the HX series. Our proposal follows.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.97; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.12; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

If Option A suits you, please tell us directly. We will review it carefully alongside the other bids.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
